descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii de informații
We are looking for an experienced Angular Developer with French language skills to join our development team and contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of modern web applications. The ideal candidate has strong Angular expertise, a solid understanding of front-end development principles, and the ability to collaborate effectively with French-speaking stakeholders and international teams.
Responsibilities 
Develop, maintain, and enhance web applications using Angular and TypeScript.
Build responsive, scalable, and high-performance user interfaces.
Collaborate with backend developers, UX/UI designers, and business stakeholders.
Integrate RESTful APIs and work with various backend services.
Write clean, reusable, and maintainable code.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to technical improvements.
Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize application performance.
Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement.
Communicate effectively with French-speaking clients and team members.
 Requirements 
Proven experience as an Angular Developer.
Strong knowledge of Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
Experience with RxJS and Angular Material.
Good understanding of REST APIs and front-end architecture.
Experience with Git and modern development workflows.
Knowledge of responsive web design and cross-browser compatibility.
Good problem-solving and analytical skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of an international team.
 French language proficiency (B2/C1 level). 
Good English communication skills.
 Nice to Have 
Experience with NgRx or other state management solutions.
Knowledge of Node.js.
Experience with automated testing tools such as Jasmine, Karma, or Jest.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
